urls.rationale: Title 24 - Legislature and Laws contains the Legislative Lobbyist Disclosure Act (La. R.S. 24:50-63) - one of the two parallel lobbying-disclosure regimes.
Title 49 - State Administration contains the Executive Branch Lobbying Disclosure Act (La. R.S. 49:71-83) - the other of the two parallel lobbying-disclosure regimes.

notes: Intermediate pass-2 selection: revised-statutes/ is a title-list page, so the chosen URLs are title-level (not chapter-level). Cascading pass-2 will descend into title-24/ and title-49/ to identify the specific chapter holding the lobbying-disclosure provisions in each body. Title 18 (Election Code) explicitly excluded - campaign finance, separate regime.
